subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: Should Feishu SDK HTTP/token and WS bootstrap requests route through OpenClaw's ambient or managed proxy agent by default when proxy env is configured?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the default decides whether Feishu app credentials and message traffic traverse a proxy boundary or bypass it, and related reports ask for both direct-bypass and proxy-required behavior.

options.title: Approve ambient/managed proxy routing
options.body: Land the linked PR if maintainers accept that Feishu HTTP and WS bootstrap should share OpenClaw's proxy agent and disable axios' separate proxy handling.

options.title: Require explicit channel policy
options.body: Pause the linked PR and ask for a channel-level proxy mode or documented policy that lets direct-bypass and proxy-required environments choose intentionally.

options.title: Keep workaround-only behavior
options.body: Leave current runtime behavior in place and rely on NO_PROXY or docs, accepting that proxy users remain blocked or fragile.

recommendation.title: Approve ambient/managed proxy routing
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR if maintainers accept that Feishu HTTP and WS bootstrap should share OpenClaw's proxy agent and disable axios' separate proxy handling.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing owner from the evidence because the decision centers on the shared ambient proxy helper and security-sensitive plugin proxy policy.
